lede: Files are processed in your browser and never leave your device.
mode_images_desc: JPG and PNG into one PDF
drop_pdf: Choose PDFs or drop them here
drop_pdf_one: Choose a PDF or drop it here
drop_img: Choose JPG or PNG images or drop them here
drop_hint_pdf: You can add several files. Up to 100 MB each.
drop_hint_img: You can add several images. Up to 50 megapixels each.
meta_notice: EXIF data and location are removed from the photos.
clear_confirm_text: Pages and their order won't be kept.
reorder_hint: Drag a page, or select it and press ← →. Delete removes, R rotates.
aria_live_picked: Page {n} picked up. Use the arrow keys to move it, Space to drop, Esc to cancel.
range_hint: Separate with commas, ranges with a hyphen.
extract_hint: Select pages on the thumbnails. They'll be saved as one PDF.

split_result_zip.one: You'll get {n} file: {list}, in a ZIP.
split_result_zip.other: You'll get {n} files: {list}, in a ZIP.

every_result: You'll get {n} files of up to {k} pages each, in a ZIP.
proc_note: Keep this tab open. Files are not sent anywhere.
proc_cancelled: Cancelled. Your files are still here.
done_merge: {pages} pages from {files} files merged into one PDF.
done_extract: Selected pages saved as a new PDF ({n} pages).
foot: Free and open source. Files stay on your device: no uploads, no cookies, no ads.

err_encrypted_fix: Remove the password in the app that created it, then add it again.
err_invalid_fix: It isn't a PDF, or the file is damaged. Try another file.
err_invalid_fix_image: This mode needs PDFs. For photos, use “Images to PDF”.
err_image_invalid_fix: This mode needs JPG or PNG images. For PDFs, use “Merge”.

err_range_fix.other: This file has {n} pages. Use numbers from 1 to {n}, like 1-3, 5.

err_too_large_fix: Split it into parts or choose a smaller file.
err_too_large_unpacked_fix: Re-save or compress it in another PDF app, then add it again.
err_total_large_fix: Remove some files and merge them separately.
err_too_many_pages_fix: This would make {n} pages. Remove some files or pages.
err_too_many_files_fix: We added 50. The other {n} weren't added; merge them next.
err_too_many_files_fix_images: We added 50. The other {n} weren't added; make a separate PDF from them.
err_image_too_large_fix: Make the image smaller, then add it again.
err_failed_fix: Try again. If that doesn't help, reload the page.
